spec: LOOK_LOCK v0.1 fixes (design specs/LOOK_LOCK.md; D2273, D2274, D2278; Vincent, Wed Nov 4, 2026: "Look lock: all defaults")
_about: Ours, not a design copy. The three new look keys the look lock needs, so a main character no longer shares a coat-and-hair set with anyone. Associate Juniper keeps the Associate coat (wine, soot trim, crimson bag) with her own long black hair; Tobin and the plain Associate keep `associate`. Archivist Mo keeps the Keeper clerk coat (green, white trim) with her own white bob and glasses; Clerk Wynn, the Cadet, the Keeper reader and the High Charity clerk keep `clerk`. The Junior Bright gets its own Glimmer-set look (wine coat, soot trim, white buttons, the lanyard) in place of the `holder_glimmer_set` reference look. No key is removed or renamed; nothing is written to the save. tests/look_lock.spec.js reads data/look_lock.json for the locked signatures.

speakers._note: cobblecrest.json (verbatim, AGENTS rule 8) still says `associate` for Associate Juniper; this overlay comes later, so her portrait and every unlooked Juniper map object wear `juniper`.
